description: Read `GET /v1/service_token` and `GET /v1/api_key` as one page. The spec gives both `limit` and `starting_after`, so they were paged by keyset, but observed live 2026-11-18 both ignore the two parameters and always return every token: with three service tokens in the org, `?limit=1` returned all three, and `?limit=1&starting_after=<first id>` returned the same three again (the same for `GET /v1/api_key` as a service account holding three tokens). Paging by keyset therefore fetched the full list twice and `.items` yielded each token twice. The other 22 keyset lists in the spec honour both parameters on the same probe.
